messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 7 March, 07:00–11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable this Saturday 7 March between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and the time-recording system are unaffected.

If you have an urgent need to access documents during the window, contact the helpdesk on ext. 4357.

Regards,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
